result.title: Training-Free Predictive Spatio-Temporal Token Pruning for Few-Step Autoregressive Video Diffusion
result.summary: Few-step autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models generate videos chunk by chunk and have made efficient video generation practical. However, further accelerating these models toward real-time generation remains challenging, as few-step distillation leaves little cross-step redundancy for existing training-free caching methods to exploit. We revisit this regime and identify two token-level redundancy patterns: cross-frame redundancy from static content shared across adjacent frames, and cross-step redundancy from tokens that converge early during denoising. Crucially, we find that early clean estimates along the model's own denoising trajectory provide an effective online signal for locating both patterns, requiring no retraining, auxiliary predictor, or reference video. Based on these findings, we propose PreSTP (Predictive Spatio-Temporal Token Pruning), a training-free framework that constructs a unified token-wise redundancy mask from cross-frame similarity and cross-step convergence. Tokens marked as redundant skip subsequent computation under a consistent last-computed-value restoration rule, and a content-adaptive mask reuse strategy further reduces dense probing cost. On 5-second generation, PreSTP achieves 1.52x-3.20x speedups and a better efficiency-fidelity trade-off than coarse-grained caching baselines such as TeaCache and FlowCache. On 30-second generation, it reaches up to 1.96x speedup while improving VBench-Long and suppressing long-horizon drift. Notably, it continues to reduce inference cost even in the extreme one-step regime, where cross-step redundancy vanishes entirely and coarse step-wise caching is no longer applicable.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PreSTP，一种无需训练的视频扩散加速框架：利用去噪轨迹早期的干净估计作为在线信号，识别跨帧静态内容与跨步提前收敛这两类 token 冗余，生成统一冗余掩码并跳过后续计算。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属视频扩散生成的推理加速（token 剪枝与缓存），冗余来自帧间相似与去噪步收敛，与 LVR 关注的推理状态表示、证据获取、停止决策均无实质关联，其效率机制绑定于扩散去噪轨迹，难以作为 latent 推理方法线索。
